items.title: What Does CVS Health (CVS) Updated COVID Vaccine Rollout Mean For Patients?
items.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) announced the rollout of updated 2026 to 2027 COVID-19 vaccines across CVS Pharmacy and MinuteClinic locations. The new vaccines are positioned for broad availability through CVS Health’s nationwide network of retail pharmacies and in store clinics. CVS Health highlighted the vaccines as part of its role in supporting ongoing COVID-19 management and wider public health efforts. This fresh 2026 to 2027 COVID-19 vaccine rollout at CVS Health sits against a wider backdrop...

items.title: Attack of the Clones Speeds Up CVS Strategy
items.summary: “No, I don’t think so,” answered Joon Sung Park, co-founder and CEO at “digital twin” startup Simile, on the opening day of the Leadership Institute’s WSJ Technology Council Summit yesterday.  Twins created with Simile are currently helping  CVS Health  make decisions more quickly and confidently, executives said as part of the same discussion.  When the pharmacy and insurance company wanted to encourage adoption of lower-cost biologic drug alternatives, twins of the consumer pool suggested that people wanted to hear recommendations from their healthcare providers, said  Tilak Mandadi,  executive vice president of ventures and chief experience and technology officer at CVS Health.
